action: Update Telegram on every device. Until the dispute is settled, do not launch widgets or start unfamiliar bots, and avoid opening unknown channels on work machines.
exec: A disputed flaw in a widely used messenger may allow malware delivery; Kaspersky gave no victim numbers or technical detail.
plain: Security researchers say Telegram's new widgets feature can be abused to run malware on phones and PCs. Telegram says the problem is fixed and disputes that users were at risk.
summary: Days after Telegram launched widgets, V12 showed a bot interaction opening an app on Android, and Kaspersky suspects a widget flaw delivered WebRAT. NebuSec now claims two ways to run code outside Telegram's new Android seccomp filter, shown on a test server. Telegram says the issue is fixed; no CVE or fixed version is known.
title: Kaspersky warns Telegram's new widgets may be delivering WebRAT malware; Durov disputes

validation.note: SecurityWeek and The Hacker News read; NebuSec's bypass claims and Kaspersky's suspicion are unconfirmed by Telegram, which disputes them.

review.note: SecurityWeek and THN: Kaspersky WebRAT suspicion, V12 demo, NebuSec claims on test server, Telegram fix and Durov dispute, no CVE; status developing.
